skill_name: Research the natural disasters most commonly experienced in India.
workflow: The natural disasters most commonly experienced in India are floods, cyclones, droughts, landslides, avalanches, extreme temperature events, earthquakes, and air pollution. Floods usually occur during monsoon season, caused by excessive rainfall and poor infrastructure. Cyclones are intense low-pressure cyclonic storms that cause heavy rains and strong wind gusts, often leading to flooding and death.
